CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `competitorKeywords` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `clientId` int NOT NULL,
  `competitorUrl` varchar(512) NOT NULL,
  `keyword` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `estimatedPosition` int,
  `searchVolume` int,
  `difficulty` varchar(16),
  `opportunityScore` int,
  `isGap` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `runId` int,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `gapAnalysisRuns` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `clientId` int NOT NULL,
  `competitorUrls` text NOT NULL,
  `totalGapKeywords` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `status` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `errorMessage` text,
  `createdBy` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `completedAt` timestamp NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `savedKeywords` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `clientId` int NOT NULL,
  `crmClientId` int,
  `keyword` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `searchVolume` int,
  `difficulty` int,
  `relevance` varchar(32),
  `savedBy` int,
  `notes` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `seoAuditHistory` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `clientId` int,
  `crmClientId` int,
  `websiteUrl` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `overallScore` int,
  `seoScore` int,
  `readabilityScore` int,
  `technicalSeoScore` int,
  `wordCount` int,
  `imgWithoutAlt` int,
  `pageTitle` varchar(500),
  `issuesJson` text,
  `strengthsJson` text,
  `improvementsJson` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `keywordRankings` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `savedKeywordId` int NOT NULL,
  `crmClientId` int,
  `keyword` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `position` int,
  `url` varchar(500),
  `searchEngine` varchar(32) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'google',
  `recordedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `keywordRankAlerts` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `savedKeywordId` int NOT NULL,
  `crmClientId` int NOT NULL,
  `keyword` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `thresholdPosition` int NOT NULL,
  `alertEmail` varchar(255),
  `isActive` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `lastTriggeredAt` timestamp NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `gapKeywordBriefs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `crmClientId` int NOT NULL,
  `keyword` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `competitorDomain` varchar(255),
  `searchIntent` varchar(64),
  `targetAudience` text,
  `recommendedTitle` text,
  `recommendedWordCount` int,
  `headingsJson` text,
  `internalLinksJson` text,
  `writingBrief` text,
  `callToAction` text,
  `seoTipsJson` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
